scripts.dev: test -f .env || cp .env.example .env; test -f build/admin.js || npm run build; ./scripts/dev-up && npm run watch
scripts.dev:daemon: test -f .env || cp .env.example .env; test -f build/admin.js || npm run build; ./scripts/dev-up && npm run watch:daemon
scripts.start: test -f .env || cp .env.example .env; composer install --no-interaction 2>/dev/null || true; npm run build && ./scripts/dev-up && ./scripts/dev-init
scripts.reset:setupwizard: ./scripts/wp option update complyops_setup_complete 0 && ./scripts/wp option update complyops_setup_pending 1 && ./scripts/wp option update complyops_setup_dismissed_forever 0
scripts.reset:tutorial: ./scripts/wp option update complyops_tutorial_complete 0 && ./scripts/wp option update complyops_tutorial_dismissed_forever 0
